hero.headline: Geelong timber gates and carpentry, built to last.
hero.subhead: Gates, decks and timber work for homes and small acreage across Geelong, the Bellarine and the Surf Coast. Send the job through and get a clear written quote.

skyeGreeting: G'day, I'm the Carpentry By Freeman assistant. Got a gate, deck or bit of timber work in mind? Tell me about it and I'll help you get a quote or book a time.

about.headline: You look after the property. We handle the timber work properly.
about.body: Most people want a carpenter who answers, gives a straight price and builds something that's still square in ten years. Every gate, deck and repair is planned around that, from the first measure to the last bolt.

cards.title: Small acreage & lifestyle blocks
cards.body: Braced timber gates that swing true, latch properly and keep the animals in.

cards.title: Homes on the Bellarine & Surf Coast
cards.body: Decks and outdoor timber work that stand up to salt air and coastal weather.

cards.title: Odd jobs that keep getting put off
cards.body: Sagging gates, rotten boards and repairs fixed properly instead of patched.

about.closing: Not sure exactly what you need? Tell us about the job and we'll talk it through.

problems.headline: Getting a carpenter out in Geelong shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Unreturned calls & slow quotes
points.body: You leave messages and Facebook DMs and still don't have a price weeks later.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: A rough figure over the phone that grows once the timber's on site.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: Start dates slip and the gate stays tied up with rope for another month.

points.title: Messy job sites
points.body: Offcuts, screws and packaging left in the paddock when the job's done.

problems.bridge: You shouldn't have to chase a tradie just to get a clear quote.

solutions.headline: Honest timber work, built around clear communication.

services.title: Timber gates
services.body: Braced timber farm and driveway gates, hung level on solid posts with proper hardware.

services.title: Decks & pergolas
services.body: New decks, board replacement and pergolas, fixed to handle Geelong's wind and coastal weather.

services.title: General carpentry & repairs
services.body: Framing, fixing and repairs around the home, done properly the first time.

process.headline: We listen to what you need. Quote it clearly. Build it right.

steps.title: Request your quote
steps.body: Send a few details with the form or give us a ring. A suburb and a rough idea is plenty.

steps.title: Site visit & clear scope
steps.body: We measure up, talk through timber and options, and put the scope and price in writing.

steps.title: Clean, on-time work
steps.body: A start date you can plan around, with the site tidied at the end of each day.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.body: We check the job with you, swing the gate, walk the deck, and sort anything before we call it done.

why.headline: We're not here to rush the job. We're here to do it properly.

themes.title: Carpentry-focused
themes.body: Timber work is the whole job, not a side line.

themes.title: Clear written quotes
themes.body: Scope and price in writing before any work starts.

themes.title: Clean & respectful
themes.body: Offcuts and packaging taken away, the yard or paddock left tidy.

themes.title: Direct communication
themes.body: You talk to the carpenter building it, start to finish.

finalCta.headline: Ready to sort that gate, deck or timber job?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a clear written quote before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward conversation about your job.

faq.a: Send the job through the form or give us a ring. We'll ask a few questions, come out to measure up if it's needed, then send a written quote with the scope and price.

faq.q: Which areas around Geelong do you cover?
faq.a: Geelong and Lara, the Bellarine Peninsula and the Surf Coast. A bit further out? Ask anyway.
Ask when you request a quote and we'll send through the licence and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: Can you build a gate to fit an existing opening?
faq.a: Yes. Send the width and a photo of the posts if you can. We'll check whether the posts are sound enough to hang it on or need replacing, and quote it either way.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to talk through the job and arrange a measure-up if it needs one.
